audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 are marked Yone/Skill while the packet chart and their own whys give all three to Nautilus; First item is marked Yone though its why says it only evens out.
audit.why: Before Spirit Cleave ramps, the pull into passive root is a clean trade Yone answers only by spending Soul Unbound (22s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 Nautilus; First item Skill; 2+ items Yone.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 2-3, the even level-6 ult trade, his first crit/AS item and his 2-item mobility takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is tracked without its cooldown, and the Mortal Steel knock-up tell is described only as 'his Q3'.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s and returns him to his body when it ends, repeating part of the damage he dealt — that snap-back is the window you engage into. Mortal Steel's second stack is the dash-plus-knockup, so the tell is the stack count, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Number the 22s cooldown and name Mortal Steel's second-stack knock-up.

edits.before: Q-hook his combo — chain CC, W-shield his Q3. Nautilus wins the Soul Unbound cooldown windows.
edits.after: Hook him while Soul Unbound is down — a 22s window where your CC chain actually sticks.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. CC in it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 22s at rank 1, and he snaps back to his body when it ends — engage on its cooldown.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Mortal Steel's second stack dashes him in with a knock-up — sidestep the third Q.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: When E ends he repeats part of that damage — do not stand in it.

notes: Chart rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped as one paired group to match the packet chart and the existing whys. Added Soul Unbound's 22s rank-1 cooldown and the Mortal Steel second-stack knock-up tell.
